description: This PHP source file defines the ViewDashlet class, which is a view component for managing dashlet layouts within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder interface. It handles rendering, AJAX responses, and title parameters for the dashlet editing interface.

classes.name: ViewDashlet
classes.description: A class extending ViewListView, responsible for rendering and managing the dashlet view within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, including AJAX handling and Smarty template preparation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ViewDashlet object with request parameters, sets module and layout context, and handles translation for module names.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters used for the module title, including translation and module name.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: An override placeholder method to prevent parent preDisplay actions which attempt to load a bean.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet view, optionally as a preview, using Smarty templates, and manages AJAX content.

methods.name: constructAjax
methods.description: Builds and returns an AJAX response object with breadcrumb navigation based on context.

methods.name: constructSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and returns a Smarty template object configured with necessary variables and UI components for editing the dashlet layout.

methods.name: _constructTitle
methods.description: Generates the title string for the dashlet editing page, including module name and label.
